name: registration_otp
description: Label Nine web app OTP — use Copy code in WhatsApp Manager (NOT zero-tap / one-tap; those require a native Android app).

do_not_use: Zero-tap autofill — requires Android package name + 11-char app signature hash
One-tap autofill — requires native mobile app linked to WhatsApp
steps: WhatsApp Manager → Message templates → Create template
Select: Copy code (customer copies OTP and pastes on labelnine.in)
Leave App setup empty — not needed for web
Content is fixed by Meta: "{{1}} is your verification code. For your security, do not share this code."
Note the template name Meta assigns (e.g. authentication_code_copy_code_button or your custom name)
Set WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_REGISTRATION_OTP to that exact name in .env

fixed_body_by_meta: {{1}} is your verification code. For your security, do not share this code.

body_variables.maps_to: 6-digit OTP only — no customer name in auth templates

utility_alternative.note: If you prefer a custom message with customer name, create a Utility template instead and set WHATSAPP_OTP_TEMPLATE_STYLE=utility in .env
utility_alternative.body: Hi {{1}}, your Label Nine verification code is {{2}}. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this code with anyone.

fast2sms_dlt.template_text: Dear {#var#}, your Label Nine verification code is {#var#}. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share. - Label Nine
